_metadata.description: Declarative, hardware-aware, licence-aware model registry with checksum-verified installs and a disk floor.

requirements.title: Declarative registry with hardware gates
requirements.description: Every model is declared with operations, architecture, backend, approximate disk size, and hardware gates (min_vram_gb, min_ram_gb, cpu_capable); selection refuses a model whose gates the host cannot meet rather than failing at inference time.

validation.notes: Schema-backed registry and hardware metadata are covered by the shipped model tests

requirements.title: Capability labels carry licence and lineage
requirements.description: Every registry entry declares license, commercial_use, commercial_use_notes, base_model_lineage, and known_risks; an entry missing any of these fails registry conformance.

validation.notes: Model capability and licence metadata are covered by the shipped model tests

requirements.title: Installs are checksum-verified and disk-gated
requirements.description: Model installation verifies a recorded checksum and refuses to begin when free disk would fall below the declared floor after download, reporting the shortfall rather than filling the volume.

validation.notes: Model install-state and checksum metadata are covered by the shipped model tests
